Re-enable a dismissed or snoozed recommendation

## Synopsis

```text
Remove a dismissal or snooze from a recommendation so it reappears
in the default recommendation listing.

This operates on local state only and does not require plugin connections.
```

```text
finfocus cost recommendations undismiss <recommendation-id> [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
  # Re-enable a dismissed recommendation
  finfocus cost recommendations undismiss rec-123abc

  # Skip confirmation prompt
  finfocus cost recommendations undismiss rec-123abc --force
```

## Options

```text
  -f, --force[=true|false]   Skip confirmation prompt
  -h, --help[=true|false]    help for undismiss
```
